notes.title: Patch 2.2
notes.content:
Instead of pressing L or Spacebar to attack the keys to attack are now B and Spacebar. This was changed because it is easier for players to use the B key as opposed to L when using the Arrow Key configuration instead of the WASD configuration. B is more useable for either the WASD configuration or the Arrow Key configuration. Spacebar is also available for players who liked the original configuration.

Thank You for reading this message

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content: This update is to further address the issue in which the blade randomly stops swinging when you are slashing enemies you can now press L key instead if the spacebar does not work with you. The update also fixes some minor issues related to the UI.

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
This patch is to address some of the issues some of the players have been having with the game.

[list]
[*] The first issue fixed was when the blade randomly stops swinging when you are slashing enemies. Now you should be able to swing it without it randomly stopping. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] The second issue fixed was that the amount of sword slashes to kill an enemy has been decreased. Some players have complained that you need too many swings to kill an enemy. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] The third change was decreasing the health regeneration of the player to compensate for the faster kill time due to the player needing less slashes to kill an enemy.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The fourth change was increasing the amount of damage the shooter's bullets can do. This was added to increase the difficulty as well to compensate for the faster kill time
[/list]
[list]
[*] The fifth change is that some levels have more enemies.
[/list]

If there are any more issues with the game please let me know. I apologize for the inconvenience some of you have had with the game and I have tried to patch some of the issues you all described. Especially the one where the sword would randomly stop swinging. Once again thank you all for playing the game regardless of whether you liked it or not. I appreciate it!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
This patch is intended to fix the some issues and glitches with the game.

[list]
[*]leaderboard display
[/list]
[list]
[*]there was a glitch where there was landing detection on the walls which allowed you to go over to the other side
[/list]

Hopefully those issues are fixed. If there are any more please let me know. Otherwise thank you for playing and I apologize for the inconvenience.
